correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the disjointness graph and reproduced the entire enumeration with block masks, not either supplied program. Distinct intersecting two-subsets have distance two via their common disjoint complement. For each nonempty block, precomputed the mask of the 105 unordered edge pairs distinguished using the minimum of endpoint distances. Recursion takes each block containing the least remaining vertex, giving exactly one path per unordered partition; all 105 bits must be covered. The replay counted 115975 partitions, with accepted counts (0,0,0,40,11965,14877,5045,720,45,1) for 1–10 blocks, totaling 32693. All four-block optima have sizes (1,3,3,3) and their set equals the 40 distinct images of the stated witness under all 120 ground permutations. Independently recovered the 105 and 15 three-block screen counts and checked that the latter partitions have two adjacent singleton blocks. Replay: python3 /workspace/reviews/petersen_replay.py. The frozen scripts and logs were inspected but not executed. This is an exhaustive finite verification for the Petersen graph only.
